description:
List an OpenAI-compatible model endpoint on the AIBTC Inference Marketplace and get paid a flat price per request that you set, in sBTC (default) or USDCx. Signs a registration message with the unlocked payout wallet (proving ownership) and POSTs it. The gateway verifies the signature recovers to payoutAddress, that the endpoint is reachable AND actually serving inference, and that model ids are real/commercial Hugging Face repos — then lists it. Requires an unlocked wallet on the gateway's network.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

acceptedToken.description: Token callers pay in: sBTC (default) or USDCx. Sets the unit of pricePerRequest.

allowUnsafeGateway.description: Allow a gateway host outside localhost / *.aibtc.com. Required to send wallet-signed headers (and any apiKey) to an arbitrary host — leave unset unless you deliberately self-host the gateway.

apiKey.description: Optional: a key your endpoint requires. Locks the endpoint so only the gateway (which presents it) can call it.

endpoint.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL, e.g. https://my-host/v1 (must expose /models and /chat/completions).

gateway.description: Marketplace gateway base URL. Defaults to https://inference.aibtc.com. Use http://localhost:8787 for local dev.

models.description: Hugging Face repo ids you serve, e.g. ["Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct"].

name.description: Display name for your node, e.g. "Alice's Qwen node".

payoutAddress.description: Stacks address that receives sBTC. Defaults to the unlocked wallet's address (must match the gateway network).

pricePerRequest.description: Flat price per request, as a whole number in the accepted token's base unit: sats for sBTC ("5" = 5 sats), 0.000001 USDCx for USDCx ("2000" = 0.002 USDCx). No decimals.

name: inference_register_provider
